plugins.name: Python Snippets
plugins.description_short: Ready-made Python code: main block, functions, classes, loops, file I/O, try/except, dataclass, argparse.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: PHP Snippets
plugins.description_short: Ready-made PHP code: page template, functions, classes, forms, PDO database, JSON API, sessions.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: Next.js Snippets
plugins.description_short: Ready-made Next.js (App Router) code: page, layout, client component, API route, server action, loading, metadata.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: CSS Snippets
plugins.description_short: Ready-made CSS: reset, flexbox center, grid layout, media query, variables, animation, card, button, dark mode.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: JavaScript Snippets
plugins.description_short: Ready-made JavaScript: functions, async fetch, DOM events, classes, array helpers, debounce, localStorage, Node server.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: Python
plugins.description_short: Python language support: auto-complete, hover docs, go to definition and lint warnings (pylsp with pyflakes and pycodestyle).
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: BasedPyright
plugins.description_short: Fast Python type checking and IntelliSense with BasedPyright (built on the open-source Pyright engine): auto-complete, type errors, hover docs, go to definition.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: C/C++
plugins.description_short: C and C++ support with clangd: auto-complete, errors as you type, go to definition, formatting.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: Java
plugins.description_short: Java support with Eclipse JDT Language Server: auto-complete, errors, imports, refactoring. Installs OpenJDK (large download, first time only).
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: Kotlin
plugins.description_short: Kotlin syntax highlighting and language support (kotlin-language-server): auto-complete, errors, go to definition. Installs Java 17 (first time only).
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: Dart
plugins.description_short: Dart language support with the official Dart analysis server: auto-complete, errors, quick fixes. Installs the Dart SDK (about 140 MB, experimental build for the app terminal).
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: Go
plugins.description_short: Go support with gopls: auto-complete, errors, imports, formatting with gofumpt.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: Rust Analyzer
plugins.description_short: Rust support with rust-analyzer: auto-complete, errors, inlay hints, go to definition. Installs Rust and Cargo.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: PHP Intelephense
plugins.description_short: PHP IntelliSense with Intelephense: auto-complete, hover docs, go to definition, errors.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: Flutter Snippets
plugins.description_short: Ready-made Flutter widget code: app, StatelessWidget, StatefulWidget, Scaffold, ListView.builder, Column/Row, FutureBuilder, navigation. Note: building and running Flutter apps needs a computer; on the phone you can write and edit the code.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: REST Client
plugins.description_short: Send HTTP requests from .http / .rest files and see the response in a new tab. Variables with @name = value and {{name}}. Separate requests with ###.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: OpenAPI (Swagger) Editor
plugins.description_short: Write OpenAPI / Swagger specs with YAML language server (auto-complete and validation from the OpenAPI schema), snippets, and a live Swagger UI preview.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: GraphQL
plugins.description_short: GraphQL syntax highlighting (.graphql, .gql), language server (auto-complete and validation from your schema via graphql.config) and snippets.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: Prisma
plugins.description_short: Prisma schema support: highlighting for .prisma files, official Prisma language server (auto-complete, errors, formatting) and model snippets. Terminal commands for prisma generate / migrate.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: Svelte
plugins.description_short: Svelte support: .svelte highlighting, the official Svelte language server (auto-complete, errors, go to definition in markup, script and style) and component snippets.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: Angular Language Service
plugins.description_short: Angular template intelligence with the official Angular language server: auto-complete, errors and go to definition in templates. Experimental on phone (needs your project's node_modules for best results). Plus component and service snippets.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: React Native Tools
plugins.description_short: React Native snippets (components, hooks, StyleSheet, FlatList, navigation) and terminal commands. Auto-complete for JS/TS comes from the built-in TypeScript server. Building the app needs a computer or Expo.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: Expo Tools
plugins.description_short: Expo snippets (app.json, Expo Router screens, layouts) and terminal commands: create app, start dev server with tunnel (scan the QR in Expo Go), install packages. Experimental on phone.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: Firebase
plugins.description_short: Firebase snippets (init, Auth, Firestore CRUD, Storage, security rules) and Firebase CLI commands in the terminal: login, init, deploy, emulators.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: MongoDB
plugins.description_short: MongoDB snippets (Node driver, Mongoose models, queries, aggregation) and MongoDB Shell (mongosh) in the terminal: connect with your connection string (Atlas works).
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: Live Server
plugins.description_short: Serve your project at http://127.0.0.1:5500 with live reload: every save refreshes the page in the in-app browser.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: HTML CSS Support
plugins.description_short: Auto-complete CSS class names inside class="..." (and className) from your project's .css/.scss/.less files and <style> blocks. HTML and CSS language servers are on.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: JS Debugger
plugins.description_short: Debug JavaScript with the Node.js inspector in the terminal: breakpoints (debugger; or sb(line)), step over/in/out, watch and inspect variables in repl. Also run the current file with Node.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: Auto Rename Tag
plugins.description_short: Rename an HTML/XML/JSX opening tag and the matching closing tag changes too (and the other way around). Works in .html, .xml, .svg, .vue, .svelte, .php, .jsx, .tsx.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: CSS Peek
plugins.description_short: Jump from a class or id in HTML/JSX to its CSS rule in your project's .css/.scss/.less files.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: Tailwind CSS IntelliSense
plugins.description_short: Tailwind class auto-complete, hover previews of the generated CSS, and lint warnings using the official Tailwind CSS language server.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: ESLint
plugins.description_short: Find and fix problems in JavaScript/TypeScript with ESLint: errors and warnings as you type, quick fixes. Uses your project's eslint config.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: Prettier
plugins.description_short: Format code with Prettier (JS, TS, JSX, CSS, SCSS, HTML, JSON, Markdown, YAML, GraphQL, Vue). Turn on format on save.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: Vue
plugins.description_short: Vue 3 support with the official Vue language server: auto-complete, errors and go to definition in templates, script and style. Plus component snippets.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: Git History
plugins.description_short: Git inside the editor: inline blame on the current line (who changed it and when), commit details, file history with diffs, and Source Control page to commit, push and pull.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: Git Graph
plugins.description_short: See your repository history as a colored commit graph with branches and tags. Tap a commit to see its changes. Switch or create branches.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: GitHub Pull Requests
plugins.description_short: Work with GitHub pull requests: list, view, see the diff, checkout, comment, approve, merge, and create new PRs (GitHub CLI).
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: GitHub Repos
plugins.description_short: Pick any of your GitHub repositories (or paste a URL) and clone it into Projects on your phone; it opens in the editor right away.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: Project Manager
plugins.description_short: Save your project folders and switch between them in two taps.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: SQLite Viewer
plugins.description_short: Open .db / .sqlite files: list tables, browse rows and run any SQL query with results shown as a table. Create new databases too.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: SQL Tools
plugins.description_short: Connect to SQLite, MySQL/MariaDB and PostgreSQL. Save connections, browse tables and run the SQL statement under the cursor (or the selection) from any .sql file.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: API Client
plugins.description_short: A simple Postman-like screen: pick the method, enter URL, headers and body, Send and see status, time, headers and pretty JSON. Keeps your last 30 requests.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: Docker
plugins.description_short: Dockerfile language server and snippets, plus control a Docker server over SSH: containers (logs, shell, restart, stop), images, compose up/down, build. Containers cannot run on the phone itself.
plugins.author: Code Gallery

plugins.name: SSH Remote
plugins.description_short: Save SSH servers and connect in the terminal, create an SSH key, upload the current file (scp), sync your project folder to the server (rsync). Edit remote files with the built-in SFTP folder.
plugins.author: Code Gallery
